title: Left difference quotients in [0, ∞] at a point of differentiability
statement: Let F : ℝ → ℝ be differentiable at t ∈ ℝ. Then liminf_{h→0⁺} ENNReal.ofReal(h⁻¹) · ENNReal.ofReal(F(t) − F(t − h)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal(F′(t)), with the liminf taken along the filter 𝓝[>] 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (t : ℝ), DifferentiableAt ℝ F t → liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal h⁻¹ * ENNReal.ofReal (F t - F (t - h))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (deriv F t)
